name: com.tencent.ai.tvs.receiver.MediaChangedReceiver
description: When the app receives a playback-status broadcast from QQ Music Watch, this Tencent Yunxiaowei TVS receiver updates the current media state so voice control can track that player.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents TVS from tracking QQ Music Watch playback changes, so related voice-control features may stop working.
